messages:
Alex Chen: hey folks — hitting a snag getting fully onboarded. Okta enrollment hung at 'Verify device' after I scanned the QR in 1Password. Google Workspace says account not active yet when I try to sign in. Can someone point me to the right queue?
Maria (People Ops): welcome Alex :wave: — tagging Jamal for IT. Did you get the 1Password invite link?
Alex Chen: yes got the 1Password invite and set a master password. I see the Okta app in 1Password and scanned the MFA QR into the app. The Okta flow in browser never advances past the device check screen.
Jamal (IT): @Alex — sorry about that. Two quick checks: 1) did you enroll any passkey/fido device already? 2) can you paste the exact error text or screenshot?
Alex Chen: I haven't registered a FIDO key. Error text is: "Waiting for device verification... No response from authenticator." (screenshot pasted)
Priya (Security): Alex, if you try another browser (incognito) does it change? Okta sometimes gets confused if there's an old cookie from GMail sign-in. Also confirm you're on the corporate network or VPN?
Alex Chen: tried Chrome normal + incognito, same result. I'm on my home network; haven't installed corp VPN yet.
Lina (Manager): Jamal — we need Alex up by EOD, can you prioritize?
Jamal (IT): on it. @Maria can you confirm Alex's Google Workspace account provisioning timestamp? Sometimes Okta enrollment waits for Google SSO to be active.
Maria (People Ops): admin console shows account created 18 minutes ago, invites sent. Status: pending acceptance (maybe Alex didn't click a specific activation link?). Alex — did you accept the invite email from Google?
Alex Chen: oh hmm I only clicked the okta invite link. I don't see a recent Google invite in my personal inbox, could it be sent to my work email?
Maria (People Ops): it would be sent to your work address (alex.chen@redwood.ai). Check spam/Promotions. If not, I'll resend.
Alex Chen: found it in spam, clicking now...
okta-bot: Your Okta MFA enrollment is pending. If Google SSO isn't active, enrollment may fail.
Alex Chen: clicked Google accept, redirected to a page saying "Account setup complete". Going back to Okta flow... still stuck.
Jamal (IT): OK — doing a quick backend check. Alex, can you try removing the Okta entry from 1Password and re-scanning the QR? Also try using the builtin authenticator on your phone (Google Authenticator / Authy) as a temporary fallback.
Alex Chen: removed and re-scanned, same "Waiting for device verification". Tried Authy on phone, it asked for code but Okta didn't show a field to enter code.
Priya (Security): sounds like the Okta flow is waiting for a push to a registered device (WebAuthn) rather than TOTP. Jamal, could device registration mode be set to passkey-only for new enrollees? We recently enabled stricter posture for new hires in the default policy.
Jamal (IT): checking policy... yes, new SSO policy requires WebAuthn for MFA until device is registered in the MDM. That would block TOTP. Maria — do we have a mobile MDM enrollment pending for Alex?
Maria (People Ops): we triggered device enrollment via Jamf yesterday; status shows "invite sent" but Alex might need to accept. Alex — did you get a Jamf enrollment email?
Alex Chen: I saw an MDM invite link in my inbox earlier but haven't completed it. Do I need to enroll my personal laptop? I was planning to use my work laptop in a few days.
Lina (Manager): You can temporarily use your phone as a registered device or Jamal can create a temporary exception. Maria — what's the policy for personal devices?
Priya (Security): personal devices can be used for initial enrollment if the user agrees, but we prefer company-managed devices for full access. For now, we can enable a one-time bypass for Alex so they can finish onboarding, then require MDM within 72 hours.
Jamal (IT): I'll open a short-lived exception. Alex, I'm going to toggle your Okta policy to allow TOTP for 30 minutes. Try the flow again after 2 mins and use Authy to provide the code when prompted.
Alex Chen: got it — trying in 2 mins.
(2 minutes pass)
Alex Chen: success! Okta accepted the TOTP code and enrollment completed. :tada: I now can sign into the Redwood Console but I don't have access to some Slack channels yet.
Maria (People Ops): good. Jamal — please ensure 1Password is provisioned with the team vaults. Alex — you'll get an invite to the Redwood vaults; accept and then request access to specific repos as needed.
1password-bot: Welcome Alex Chen — your 1Password account has been added to the "redwood-engineering" vault. Follow the on-screen steps to finish setup: https://1password.com/welcome
Jamal (IT): Slack access is controlled by Workspace groups. I'll add you to #eng and #new-hires now. Should propagate in ~5 min. Also emailing the device enrollment instructions so you can enroll later.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help. Note to self: accept Google invite and MDM before doing Okta QR.
Lina (Manager): welcome aboard Alex! ping me if you need pairing for the first-week setup. :coffee:
